# ELLE

> > ELLE is a leading women's fashion, beauty, and lifestyle magazine covering trends, politics, culture, and astrology.

ELLE delivers authoritative coverage of fashion trends, beauty products, celebrity style, and cultural topics including women's empowerment, political activism, and social justice issues. The magazine features expert beauty advice, designer shopping guides, and daily horoscopes alongside profiles of influential women in politics and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Fashion trends and designer collections
- Beauty and skincare products
- Makeup trends and tutorials
- Women in politics and activism
- Social justice and empowerment
- Astrology and horoscopes
- Celebrity style and culture
- International affairs
- Shopping guides and product reviews
- Career profiles
- Current events and news
- Zodiac signs and compatibility
- Women's rights advocacy
- Political coverage

## Beauty & Makeup

- [Makeup & Skin Care Guide 2025 - Top Beauty Products and Skin Tips](https://www.elle.com/beauty/makeup-skin-care/): Makeup trends, skincare products, and beauty tips from experts
- [29 Best Makeup Products of 2024: Best Makeup of All Time](https://www.elle.com/beauty/makeup-skin-care/g8/best-makeup-products-ever/): Editor-curated best makeup products including Nars and top brands

## Politics & Social Issues

- [Politics and News - National and International Political Issues](https://www.elle.com/culture/career-politics/): Politics, social justice, and women's empowerment news and activism

## Astrology & Horoscopes

- [Horoscopes 2025 - Free Daily, Weekly and Monthly Horoscopes for Your Sign](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/): Daily, weekly, monthly horoscopes and zodiac compatibility by Astro Twins

## Fashion Shopping Guides

- [18 Best Designer Beach Bags 2024](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/g46614419/best-designer-beach-bags/): Designer beach bags guide featuring Zimmermann, Marc Jacobs brands
- [15 Best Capris Pants for Women 2024](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/g46672345/best-capri-pants-women/): Spring 2024 capri pants trend guide featuring Sandy Liang, Bella Hadid
